pr_title: fix(ivy): ngcc - prevent crash for packages without "main" property
pr_body:
When determining the module type of a bundle pointed to by the "main"
property, ngcc needs to read the bundle to figure out if it is CommonJS
or UMD format. However, when the "main" property does not exist ngcc
would crash while determining the path to the main bundle file.

This commit fixes the crash by checking if the "main" property is present
at all, before attempting to derive a full path to the bundle file.

Fixes #30916
Fixes FW-1369

issue_context.title: ngcc: fails with error ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report

### Affected Package

The issue is caused by package @angular/compiler-cli


### Is this a regression?

Definitely yes, this is working with version 8.0.0, not working since 8.1.0-.... 
With 8.0.0 was working much slower, but at least was working.

### Description

When you run `ivy-ngcc` on my own package it will fail with error:
> TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The "path" argument must be of type string. Received type undefined
    at validateString (internal/validators.js:125:11)
    at Object.join (path.js:1147:7)
    at Object.join (D:\git\ngcc-error\node_modules\@angular\compiler-cli\src\ngtsc\path\src\types.js:68:80)
    at Object.getEntryPointFormat (D:\git\ngcc-error\node_modules\@angular\compiler-cli\ngcc\src\packages\entry_point.js:77:56)
    at D:\git\ngcc-error\node_modules\@angular\compiler-cli\ngcc\src\main.js:85:44
    at Array.forEach (<anonymous>)
    at Object.mainNgcc (D:\git\ngcc-error\node_modules\@angular\compiler-cli\ngcc\src\main.js:75:21)
    at D:\git\ngcc-error\node_modules\@angular\compiler-cli\ngcc\main-ngcc.js:67:20
    at D:\git\ngcc-error\node_modules\@angular\compiler-cli\ngcc\main-ngcc.js:4:17
    at Object.<anonymous> (D:\git\ngcc-error\node_modules\@angular\compiler-cli\ngcc\main-ngcc.js:10:3)

## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction

`git clone https://github.com/kukjevov/ngcc-error.git`
`cd ngcc-error`
`npm install`
`git reset --hard`
`npm run ngcc`

## 🔥 Exception or Error

**TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]: The "path" argument must be of type string. Received type undefined**

## 🌍  Your Environment

**Angular Version:**
Angular/* 8.1.0-next.1
Node: v11.6.0
NPM: 6.9.0
Windows 10 1809
